virtual_energy_sensor.description: Virtual energy/water sensors linked to outputs. Creates power/energy or flow/volume sensors in Home Assistant.

id.markdownDescription:
Sensor ID

Unique identifier for the sensor. If not provided, will be generated from name.
id.title: Id

name.markdownDescription:
Sensor Name

Display name for the sensor in Home Assistant Energy panel.
Example: "Gabinet - Główne", "Kuchnia - Oświetlenie"
name.title: Name

output_id.markdownDescription:
Output ID

ID of the output to track. The sensor will measure energy/water consumption when this output is ON.
output_id.title: Output id

sensor_type.markdownDescription:
Sensor Type

Type of virtual sensor: 'power' for energy meter (W/Wh) or 'water' for flow meter (L/h, L).
sensor_type.title: Sensor type

power_usage.markdownDescription:
Power Usage

Power consumption in Watts when output is ON. Accepts values like: 10, '10W', '1kW'.
power_usage.title: Power usage

flow_rate.markdownDescription:
Flow Rate

Water flow rate when output is ON. Accepts values like: 10, '10L/h', '5L/min'.
flow_rate.title: Flow rate

area.markdownDescription:
Area

Area ID to assign this sensor to a sub-device in Home Assistant.
area.title: Area

virtual_energy_sensor.title: Virtual energy sensor
